name: Chimpanzee
group: Animals > Mammals > Wild animals on land > Eats plants and meat

features.claim: It is covered in coarse black hair.
features.quote: It is covered in coarse black hair but has a bare face, fingers, toes, palms of the hands, and soles of the feet.

features.claim: Its face, fingers, toes, palms and soles are bare of hair.
features.quote: Chimpanzee bodies are covered by coarse hair, except for the face, ears, fingers, toes, palms of the hands, and soles of the feet.

features.claim: Its arms are longer than its legs.
features.quote: The chimpanzee has longer arms than legs, with an average arm length of 83 cm (2.72 ft).

features.claim: Its hands are long with long fingers and short thumbs.
features.quote: The elongated hands have long fingers with short thumbs and flat fingernails.

features.claim: Its big toe can be turned to grasp like a thumb.
features.quote: The big toe is opposable, allowing the ape to grasp with its feet.

features.claim: Its head is rounded or flattened with a jaw that juts forward and a strong brow ridge.
features.quote: A chimpanzee's head is rounded or flattened with a forward-projecting jaw and a pronounced brow ridge.

features.claim: It has eyes facing forward, a small nose, round ears without lobes and a long flexible upper lip.
features.quote: It has forward-facing eyes, a small nose, circular non-lobed ears and a long flexible upper lip.

features.claim: Its body is short and wide, and its hips are long with a wide top.
features.quote: The body or thorax is short and wide, while the hips are long with a wide top.

features.claim: It stands about 150 cm tall on average.
features.quote: Adult chimpanzees have an average standing height of 150 cm (4 ft 11 in).

features.claim: It can walk on the ground on two legs or on all four limbs.
features.quote: On the ground, chimpanzees move both bipedally (on two legs) and quadrupedally (on all four limbs), which differ little in physical and energetic demands.

features.claim: It walks on all fours by resting on its knuckles.
features.quote: As with bonobos and gorillas, chimpanzees move quadrupedally by knuckle-walking, which probably evolved independently in Pan and Gorilla.

second_reading.claim: Its hair can also be shades of brown or ginger, and older ones may show white or grey patches.
second_reading.quote: While normally black, chimpanzee hair can also be shades of brown or ginger.
